name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.permission.QChatRolePermissionActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user edits a role's access to a channel. It lets the user set which channel actions members with that role may perform.
disableEffect: Users cannot change a role's QChat channel permissions through the built-in screen.
